THE_SPLIT_THAT_DECIDES_G.ever localised == first hypothesis corre: the agent hypothesises ONCE per episode, so there is no second chance and the two partitions coincide exactly.

what_this_means_for_G: on v2, localisation is NECESSARY and nearly SUFFICIENT: get the region right and the episode succeeds 64% of the time; get it wrong and it succeeds 0% of the time. That is the exact opposite of v1, where FORCING the correct region was worth -4.4 points (gtrivial_control.json) because the deficit there was never localisation. G has real headroom on v2 for the first time: 55 episodes currently at zero.
the_ceiling_and_why_it_is_optimistic: a head that localised perfectly would make all 80 episodes 'first hypothesis correct'. If the 64% rate held, that is ~51/80 = 64% pooled, against 20% today. But 64% is conditioned on the episodes THE AGENT ITSELF localised, which are plausibly the easier ones, so 64% is an optimistic ceiling and not a prediction.
the_harness_caveat_that_must_travel_with: 'localisation is necessary' is partly a property of this harness: the agent emits ONE hypothesis per episode, so a wrong first guess cannot be recovered from within the budget. A loop that re-hypothesised would not show 0%.
and_an_uncomfortable_comparison: v2 baseline (20.0%, 10.20 actions) is almost exactly REDACTED v1 (21.2%, 10.29 actions) -- but for a different reason. Redacted v1 left 79% of tasks with no symptom at all; v2 carries an assertion detail on 100%. Same outcome, opposite cause. It raises a question the gate did not ask: whether the model can USE a behavioural symptom at all. The agent's 31.2% first-hypothesis accuracy on v2 is BELOW the 50.6% a held-out lookup table on the symptom string scores, so it is not extracting even the signal the set concedes.

THE_BAR_FOR_G_apples_to_apples_on_the_SA.reading: the agent is below ALL THREE trivial baselines on v2. So a head that beats the AGENT proves nothing -- G's bar is the 51.2% lookup table, because anything below that is recoverable from the symptom string alone with no state access at all.
THE_BAR_FOR_G_apples_to_apples_on_the_SA.correction_to_my_own_earlier_figure: I first compared the agent's 31.2% (80 eval tasks) against the gate's 50.6% (a split-half table over all 2,000) -- two different populations. Recomputed on the same 80 it is 51.2%. The conclusion strengthens, but the comparison as first stated was not like for like.
